lanes_build_messages.jsonl.keeps: the compiler-artifact message of the lib test target mixdog_tools; paths repository-relative, executable replaced by <test binary>
lanes_build_messages.jsonl.purpose: reference capture of a compiler-artifact message, not an input to the public lanes test

lanes_list_fs_tests.json.command: the lib test binary of mixdog_tools, --list fs::tests (cwd native/core/crates/mixdog-tools)
lanes_list_fs_tests.json.purpose: reference capture of libtest list output, not an input to the public lanes test

provenance: The original recorder and slow drift test are local-only; a public checkout can inspect these captures but does not include those tools.
